text: soundness' gives a lower bound on the debate-false probability: if the oracle o satisfies o.lipschitz t k and 0 < c < s < b, 0 < q, 0 < v ≤ 1 and q ≤ v, then for any Alice strategy eve the probability that debate eve (bob s b q) (vera c s v) t returns false under o is at least (1 - v) * (1 - q) ^ (t+1) * ((o.final t).prob false - k * b).
